translated_title: Claudia Sheinbaum Projects Economic Rebound in Mexico for the Second Half of the Year

meta_description: Sheinbaum cited record car sales, booming auto-parts and electronics manufacturing, and welfare housing—plus a July 20 US visit to continue USMCA-review talks.
